{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Copyright 2020 Chris Morgan <chmorgan@gmail.com>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

name: .NET Core

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Install libpcap
      run: sudo -E bash scripts/install-libpcap.sh
    - name: Install tap
      run: sudo -E bash scripts/install-tap.sh
    - name: Build sharppcap assembly
      run: dotnet build SharpPcap/SharpPcap.csproj
    - name: Test
      run: sudo -E bash scripts/test.sh
      env:
        CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

    - run: sudo chmod -R +r Test/TestResults
      if: always()
    - name: Publish Test Report
      uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v6
      if: always()
      with:
        report_paths: Test/TestResults/TestResults.xml
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
      if: failure()
      with:
        name: artifacts
        path: Test/TestResults/

    - name: publish on version change
      id: publish_nuget
      uses: alirezanet/publish-nuget@v3.1.0
      with:
        # Filepath of the project to be packaged, relative to root of repository
        PROJECT_FILE_PATH: SharpPcap/SharpPcap.csproj

        # API key to authenticate with NuGet server
        NUGET_KEY: ${{secrets.NUGET_API_KEY}}

        # Flag to toggle pushing symbols along with nuget package to the server, disabled by default
        INCLUDE_SYMBOLS: true

  license-check:
    # We use https://github.com/fsfe/reuse-tool to ensure EVERY file has correct license and copyright info
    # Either in the file itself, or in .reuse\dep5 for binary files and files that don't support comments
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.14'
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
    - run: reuse lint
",
  "rationale": "Add pip dependency caching to the license-check job. The experiment evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) demonstrates a measured ~9% elapsed time reduction for Python dependency caching using actions/cache@v4 with a key based on the requirements file. The license-check job installs Python dependencies from requirements.txt via pip, making this optimization directly applicable while preserving all existing build and test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
